workspace_roles.world_routes: Seeded collision-safe archipelago overview assembled from actual editable scene maps with persistent harbor-to-harbor ship routes.
workspace_roles.overworld_layout: Selected-island scene-cell assembly grid with collision-checked cell movement.
workspace_roles.scene_editor: Per-scene terrain, object, zone, and transition authoring.
workspace_roles.scene_bank: Interiors, caves, dungeons, and reusable off-world scene documents.

save_all_outputs: shareable archipelago world seed and reroll index
assembly_controls: select island from World Routes or island list
Regenerate Current Seed reproduces the current layout
Reroll Archipelago Seed creates a different collision-safe layout and coastline set

pcg_layout.seed_source: shareable per-world seed persisted with the scene rectangle manifest
pcg_layout.mainland_policy: center Alderreach as an 8x5 continuous surface while retaining the legacy havenwild_mainland save namespace
pcg_layout.reroll_policy: explicit editor or Bash reroll; the same seed reproduces the same layout and coastlines
pcg_layout.future_new_game_binding: each save slot supplies its own world seed to the same layout and island generators
